packages.title: 2-Day Masai Mara Safari
packages.subtitle: A compact introduction to Africa's most celebrated wildlife reserve — two game drives, one unforgettable night in the bush.
packages.overview: This two-day safari is the ideal introduction to the Masai Mara. Departing Nairobi after breakfast, you'll arrive in time for an afternoon game drive — the golden hour light brings predators out and photographic opportunities abound. Spend the night at a classic bush camp before an early-morning drive at first light, when lions and cheetah are most active. Return to Nairobi after lunch.

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Masai Mara
itinerary.desc: Depart Nairobi at 07:00 by 4×4. Arrive Mara by noon, lunch at camp, then afternoon game drive from 15:00–18:30. Dinner and overnight at bush camp.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara → Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Early wake-up for a 06:00 game drive — the best hours for predator activity. Return to camp for breakfast, then drive back to Nairobi, arriving by 17:00.

packages.title: 3-Day Masai Mara Safari
packages.subtitle: Our most popular package — two full days of game driving give you the best odds of witnessing the Big Five on the open plain.
packages.overview: The three-day Masai Mara safari is our most-booked itinerary — and for good reason. Two full game-drive days give you real time to explore the reserve, follow lion prides, track cheetah on the open plain, and watch elephant herds move through the acacia woodland at dusk.
highlights: Two full days of game drives

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Masai Mara
itinerary.desc: Depart Nairobi at 07:00. Arrive camp by noon. Lunch, then afternoon game drive 15:00–18:30. Sundowners on the plain. Dinner and overnight.

itinerary.title: Full Day in the Mara
itinerary.desc: Full day game driving — early start at 06:00. Return to camp for lunch. Afternoon drive from 15:00, finishing at sunset. Optional Maasai village visit.

itinerary.title: Masai Mara → Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Final morning drive at 06:30. Breakfast at camp. Depart for Nairobi, arriving by 17:00.

packages.title: 4-Day Masai Mara Safari
packages.subtitle: Three game-drive days to explore multiple zones of the reserve — from the Mara Triangle to the Sand River boundary.
packages.overview: Four days allows you to properly explore the reserve's different zones. The Mara Triangle — managed by the Mara Conservancy — is less crowded and often has exceptional leopard sightings. The Sand River sector near the Tanzanian border is the epicentre of the wildebeest crossing during migration season.

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Masai Mara
itinerary.desc: Drive from Nairobi, arriving by midday. Afternoon game drive in the central Mara.

itinerary.title: Mara Triangle
itinerary.desc: Full day in the Mara Triangle — dramatically less traffic, exceptional leopard and cheetah habitat.

itinerary.title: Sand River Sector
itinerary.desc: Explore the Sand River area and Tanzanian border zones. Sundowner on the escarpment.

itinerary.title: Morning Drive → Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Final dawn drive, then breakfast and return drive to Nairobi.

packages.title: 5-Day Masai Mara Safari
packages.subtitle: An unhurried stay — time for game drives, a Maasai village immersion, and a guided dawn bush walk.
packages.overview: Five days is the sweet spot for a thorough Masai Mara experience. Beyond game drives, you'll have time for a guided walking safari with a Maasai warrior, a cultural visit to an authentic village, and an evening of stargazing from the open plain.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.desc: Drive from Nairobi, afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Game Day
itinerary.desc: All-day game drive exploring the central reserve.

itinerary.title: Mara Triangle & Bush Walk
itinerary.desc: Morning bush walk with Maasai guide, afternoon in the Triangle.

itinerary.title: Maasai Village & Game Drive
itinerary.desc: Morning village visit, afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Final Drive & Return
itinerary.desc: Dawn drive, breakfast, return to Nairobi.

packages.title: 7-Day Masai Mara Safari
packages.subtitle: A full week in the world's greatest wildlife reserve — the ultimate Masai Mara immersion.
packages.overview: Seven days is enough time to see the Masai Mara in its entirety — the main reserve, the Mara Triangle, and the surrounding private conservancies where night drives and off-road driving are permitted. Your private guide builds a daily plan around your specific wildlife priorities.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Central Mara
itinerary.desc: Drive from Nairobi. Two days exploring the main reserve.

itinerary.title: Mara Triangle
itinerary.desc: Move to a camp in the Triangle for two days of less-crowded game viewing.

itinerary.title: Private Conservancy
itinerary.desc: Stay at a conservancy camp — night drives, off-road tracking, walking safaris.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.desc: Final morning drive and return to Nairobi.

packages.title: Masai Mara Safaris From Nairobi
packages.subtitle: All our Masai Mara packages depart from and return to Nairobi by road — a scenic 5–6 hour drive through the Great Rift Valley.
packages.image_alt: Drive to Masai Mara through Rift Valley
packages.overview: All our safaris depart from Nairobi's main hotels in comfortable, pop-top 4×4 safari vehicles. The drive to the Masai Mara passes through the dramatic Great Rift Valley escarpment — a highlight in itself. We offer 2-day to 7-day departures on any date.

itinerary.title: Nairobi Hotel Pickup
itinerary.desc: Collected from your hotel at 07:00. Drive through the Rift Valley escarpment with optional stop at the viewpoint.

itinerary.title: Arrive Masai Mara
itinerary.desc: Arrive at camp around noon. Lunch and settle in.

itinerary.title: First Game Drive
itinerary.desc: Afternoon drive 15:00–18:30 before returning to camp for dinner.

packages.title: Masai Mara Fly-In Safaris
packages.subtitle: Skip the road and fly into the heart of the Mara — 45 minutes from Nairobi's Wilson Airport to a bush airstrip.
packages.image_alt: Small aircraft landing in Masai Mara
packages.overview: Flying into the Mara is the premium choice — it maximises your time in the reserve and removes the long road journey entirely. Scheduled light-aircraft flights operate from Wilson Airport (Nairobi) to multiple Mara airstrips daily.

itinerary.title: Wilson Airport → Mara Airstrip
itinerary.desc: Morning flight from Nairobi (45 min). Met at the airstrip by your guide. Afternoon game drive.

itinerary.title: Full Game Days
itinerary.desc: Dawn and dusk game drives with the reserve largely to yourself in the early hours.

itinerary.title: Return Flight
itinerary.desc: Morning drive, then fly back to Nairobi.

packages.title: Masai Mara Migration Safaris
packages.subtitle: A million wildebeest. Crocodile-filled rivers. The world's greatest wildlife spectacle — timed to perfection.
packages.overview: Between July and October each year, over 1.5 million wildebeest — along with 200,000 zebra and 500,000 gazelle — make the treacherous Mara River crossing into Kenya. The crossings happen multiple times a day at several well-known points. Our guides know the river intimately and will position you correctly for the crossing, often just metres from the action.

itinerary.title: Drive to Mara
itinerary.desc: Depart Nairobi early. Afternoon spent scouting crossing points with guide.

itinerary.title: Migration Focus
itinerary.desc: Dawn to dusk at the river crossings. Guide monitors multiple sites via radio network.

itinerary.title: Reserve Exploration
itinerary.desc: Explore the broader reserve — predators follow the herds.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.desc: Final morning at the river, then return to Nairobi.

packages.title: Luxury Masai Mara Safaris
packages.subtitle: Five-star tented camps, private game vehicles, butler service, and sundowner cocktails on the open plain.
packages.image_alt: Luxury tented camp in Masai Mara
packages.overview: Kenya's luxury safari market has no equal — the country invented the concept of the classic tented camp, and the finest properties in the Masai Mara offer an experience that combines deep wilderness with exceptional hospitality. Think Egyptian cotton, candlelit dinners under acacia trees, and a private guide who dedicates the vehicle entirely to your party.

itinerary.title: Fly In from Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Charter flight to Mara. Champagne welcome, afternoon game drive in your private vehicle.

itinerary.title: Private Game Drives
itinerary.desc: Unlimited game driving on your own schedule — no fixed departure times.

itinerary.title: Final Drive & Return
itinerary.desc: Dawn drive, breakfast in the bush, return flight to Nairobi.

packages.title: Masai Mara National Reserve
packages.subtitle: Everything you need to know about Kenya's most celebrated wildlife reserve — wildlife, best time to visit, fees, and travel tips.
packages.image_alt: Panoramic view of Masai Mara savanna
packages.overview: The Masai Mara National Reserve is managed by the Narok County Council and covers 1,510 km² of the larger 25,000 km² Mara–Serengeti ecosystem. The reserve is bordered by the Mara Triangle (managed by the Mara Conservancy) and several private conservancies where additional activities — night drives, walking safaris, off-road driving — are permitted.

itinerary.title: What You'll See
itinerary.desc: Lion, leopard, cheetah, elephant, buffalo, giraffe, hippo, crocodile, 470 bird species, and seasonal wildebeest migration.

itinerary.title: When to Visit
itinerary.desc: Year-round destination. July–October for the Great Migration. January–March for calving season in the Serengeti. Dry seasons (Jun–Oct, Dec–Mar) offer better game viewing.

itinerary.title: Access
itinerary.desc: 5–6 hour drive from Nairobi via the A104 and Narok Road, or 45-minute charter flight from Wilson Airport to Keekorok, Musiara, or Ol Kiombo airstrips.

includes: Park fees (2026): USD 80 pp/day for non-residents

packages.title: Amboseli Day Safari
packages.subtitle: A full day at Amboseli National Park — elephant herds, Kilimanjaro views, and prolific birdlife in a single long-day excursion from Nairobi.
packages.overview: Amboseli's open swamp ecosystem supports one of Africa's largest free-roaming elephant populations. On a clear day — most mornings — Kilimanjaro towers over the park in extraordinary photographic fashion.

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Amboseli
itinerary.desc: Early departure at 05:30 to arrive for peak morning wildlife activity.

itinerary.title: Game Drives
itinerary.desc: Morning and afternoon game drives around the Enkongo Narok swamp and Observation Hill.

itinerary.title: Return to Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Depart by 16:00, back in Nairobi by 20:00.

packages.title: 2-Day Amboseli Safari
packages.subtitle: Overnight at Amboseli — morning and evening game drives with Kilimanjaro lighting at its most dramatic.
packages.overview: One night in Amboseli allows you to experience the park in its best light — literally. Dawn breaks over Kilimanjaro in extraordinary clarity and the elephants move through the swamp in spectacular fashion.

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Amboseli
itinerary.desc: Drive from Nairobi (3.5 hours). Arrive for afternoon game drive and sunset.

itinerary.title: Morning Drive → Return
itinerary.desc: Early 06:00 drive for Kilimanjaro at dawn. Breakfast, then return to Nairobi.

packages.title: 3-Day Amboseli Safari
packages.subtitle: Two full game-drive days in the shadow of Kilimanjaro — Africa's most photogenic wildlife setting.
packages.overview: Three days at Amboseli gives you time to properly explore the park's five distinct habitat zones — from open plains to yellow-fever acacia woodland — and spend real time with the elephant families that Cynthia Moss studied for over 40 years.

itinerary.title: Arrival
itinerary.desc: Nairobi to Amboseli. Afternoon drive and sundowners.

itinerary.title: Full Park Day
itinerary.desc: Full day exploring all zones. Optional guided swamp walk.

itinerary.title: Return
itinerary.desc: Dawn drive with Kilimanjaro, then return to Nairobi.

packages.title: Amboseli National Park
packages.subtitle: Kenya's most photographed landscape — free-roaming elephant herds, five distinct ecosystems, and Kilimanjaro rising 5,895m on the southern horizon.
packages.overview: Amboseli National Park lies at the foot of Mount Kilimanjaro on the Tanzanian border. Its name derives from the Maasai word "empusel", meaning salty, dusty place — a reference to the ancient lakebed that forms the park's centre. The park is most famous for its large elephant herds, studied by the Amboseli Elephant Research Project since 1972.

itinerary.title: Oct–Feb
itinerary.desc: Clearest Kilimanjaro views. Excellent game viewing around the swamps as wildlife concentrates.

itinerary.title: Mar–May
itinerary.desc: Lush and green. Fewer visitors. Some tracks impassable. Bird diversity peaks.

packages.title: 2-Day Tsavo Safari
packages.subtitle: The largest protected wilderness in Kenya — red elephants, dramatic lava flows, and East Africa's greatest baobab trees.
packages.overview: Tsavo is Kenya's largest and most underrated national park — a vast wilderness that sees a fraction of the Mara's visitor numbers but offers equally dramatic wildlife encounters. The red elephants, stained by Tsavo's iron-rich soil, are legendary.

itinerary.title: Nairobi → Tsavo
itinerary.desc: Drive south (4 hours). Afternoon drive — look for the famous red elephant herds.

itinerary.title: Full Morning Drive → Return
itinerary.desc: Dawn game drive, Lugard Falls visit, then return to Nairobi.

packages.title: 3-Day Tsavo Safari
packages.subtitle: Two full days in Kenya's largest wilderness — split between Tsavo East and Tsavo West for maximum variety.
packages.overview: Splitting three days between Tsavo East and Tsavo West gives you the best of both — East's open plains and massive elephant herds, and West's dramatic volcanic scenery, hippo pools, and the crystal-clear Mzima Springs.

itinerary.title: Tsavo East
itinerary.desc: Drive from Nairobi to Tsavo East. Afternoon game drive around Aruba Dam.

itinerary.title: Tsavo West Transfer
itinerary.desc: Morning drive in East, then cross to West. Mzima Springs visit and afternoon drive.

itinerary.title: Chaimu Crater → Nairobi
itinerary.desc: Morning at Chaimu Crater and Roaring Rocks viewpoint. Return to Nairobi.

packages.title: Tsavo East National Park
packages.subtitle: Kenya's largest park — a vast, semi-arid wilderness of open plains, baobab forests, and the Galana River teeming with hippos and crocodiles.
packages.image_alt: Tsavo East landscape with red dust
packages.overview: Tsavo East National Park is the larger of the two Tsavo parks. Its flat, open landscape of red-tinged plains and scrubland makes wildlife easy to spot. The Galana River is a lifeline for hippos, crocodiles, and elephant — particularly during the dry season when the river becomes the only water source for miles.

itinerary.title: Must-See
itinerary.desc: Lugard Falls, Aruba Dam, Galana River drive, and the red elephant herds near Voi Safari Lodge.

packages.title: Tsavo West National Park
packages.subtitle: Dramatic volcanic scenery, Mzima Springs, and extraordinary diversity in a greener, more varied landscape than its eastern counterpart.
packages.image_alt: Mzima Springs hippos in Tsavo West
packages.overview: Tsavo West is the more scenically dramatic of the two parks. Volcanic craters, lava fields, and green hills contrast dramatically with the red-dust plains of East. The underwater observatory at Mzima Springs lets you watch hippos and fish from below the waterline.

itinerary.title: Must-See
itinerary.desc: Mzima Springs (underwater observatory), Chaimu Crater walk, Roaring Rocks viewpoint, Shetani Lava Flow.

faqs.question: What is the best time to visit the Masai Mara?
faqs.answer: The Mara is excellent year-round, but the Great Migration river crossings occur July–October. January–March offers the calving season on the Serengeti side of the ecosystem.

faqs.question: Do I need a visa to visit Kenya?
faqs.answer: Most nationalities require an eVisa, obtained online at evisa.go.ke before travel. Processing takes 3–5 business days. We can advise on current requirements for your nationality.

faqs.question: What vaccinations do I need for Kenya?
faqs.answer: Yellow fever vaccination is required if arriving from a yellow-fever endemic country. We recommend consulting a travel health clinic. Malaria prophylaxis is advised for safari areas.

faqs.question: How do I get from Nairobi to the Masai Mara?
faqs.answer: Options are a 5–6 hour road journey by safari vehicle or a 45-minute charter flight from Wilson Airport. We arrange both as part of your safari package.

faqs.question: Can you accommodate dietary requirements?
faqs.answer: Yes — all major camps cater for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and halal requirements with advance notice. Please inform us when booking.

faqs.question: What is your cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Full refund up to 60 days before travel. 50% refund 30–59 days. Within 30 days, the deposit is non-refundable. We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance.

faqs.question: Is Kenya safe for tourists?
faqs.answer: Kenya's national parks and Nairobi's tourist areas are very safe. We monitor travel advisories daily and have protocols for all scenarios. We have operated for 15 years without a security incident involving guests.

faqs.question: Do you offer private safaris?
faqs.answer: Yes — all our safaris can be operated privately, with a dedicated vehicle and guide for your party alone. Group departures are also available at lower per-person rates.
